data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals, a public-stage biotech company founded by Chris Gibson and Dean Li, commands a current valuation of $1.6B after raising $2B+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 11 comparable companies across Biotech & Health—3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private firms including Chai Discovery, New Limit, Freenome, Alto Neuroscience, and Eikon Therapeutics, spanning Series B through public stages.

Peer-median methodology proved applicable and anchored the primary valuation signal. Across 5 same-sector peers filtered by similar valuation tier, the median valuation is $1.1B, with a range spanning $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $3.8B (Chai Discovery, Series C). Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples was not applicable; while the Biotech & Health public sector exhibits a 6.2x median P/S across the 3 tickers, Recursion's revenue was not available to calculate an implied valuation.

The triangulation supports a range of $935M to $1.3B, centered on $1.1B. The current $1.6B valuation sits 45% above the peer median, likely reflecting Recursion's public status and earlier funding trajectory relative to the mixed-stage peer set. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to public comparables, and whether the peer set adequately reflects platform-stage biotech risk and commercial execution.
